name: Witch Hunter Deadeye pays native damage-based rage for each ranged auto attack (#7290, #7659)
contract: Deadeye 92093 (Houndmaster passive, 'Your ranged auto attacks now generate Rage') used to pay a flat 50 internal
rage per Auto Shot whatever the shot hit for. Ascension scales Auto Shot rage with damage (Zandalari Windreaver
902137 raises it through SPELL_AURA_MOD_RAGE_FROM_DAMAGE_DEALT, which only scales the damage-based part), so a shot
now pays Unit::RewardRage(damage, ranged speed x 3.5, crit doubled) like a main-hand swing. At level 60 the rage
conversion is 230.6; with the 2.5 s Light Crossbow (factor 8) every shot below 82 damage, and every crit below 164,
is capped by the damage term 15 x damage / 230.6, so rage per point of shot damage is 150 / 230.6 = 0.65 internal
less up to one truncated point per shot. Expected: shots of 25-70 damage and 0.58-0.67 internal rage per point of
Auto Shot damage. The old flat 50 gives at least 0.71 at those damage values.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Let the weapon swap cooldown expire
Let the next shot end the stream
SETUP: the target died and Auto Shot stopped
Let any projectile in flight land
SETUP: Light Crossbow shots stay in the damage-capped band
Rage scales with shot damage at 150 / 230.6 internal per point
